_about: Ride score errata and by-ear choices (score seconds). 'lead_part' makes the lead follow one part in [start, end); optional 'as' names the part the ear hears when the notes are read from a part that doubles it.

lead_part.why: Ride 2:17-2:40 (mm.118-138): the horn chorale's tune is doubled in concert pitch by the oboes / clarinet 1; the score reader's horn and alto-sax transposition is off, so the rules pick the bass and the high fanfare instead (user approved this chart earlier; to be re-confirmed by ear). Phrases 1-2 of the chorale.
Ride 2:24 (m.125): the fff horn / soprano sax 7-note turn, in the chorale's register.
Ride 2:26 (m.126): the chorale's phrase 3, read from the trumpets' line in the horns' register.
Ride 2:29-2:34 (mm.127-134): the trumpet fanfare and hits.
